function.name: log_maintenance_request
function.description: Log a tenant maintenance request once all details are collected. Returns a ticket number to read back to the caller.

callback_number.description: Best phone number to reach the tenant, confirmed by reading it back

unit.description: Unit or apartment number, if any

issue_description.description: Short summary of the problem, where it is, and when it started

urgency.description: emergency = safety risk or serious damage; urgent = major issue, no immediate danger; routine = normal repair

permission_to_enter.description: Whether maintenance may enter if nobody is home

preferred_time.description: Tenant's preferred visit window, for non-emergencies
